shot.title: 雨天：去帮母亲收衣服
shot.start_end_and_action: A wide smartphone view from just inside the glass doorway looking into the family courtyard during a light summer shower. The same boy, now six years old, wears a cream striped shirt and dark shorts. He carries a small empty laundry basin with both hands and walks from the foreground doorway toward his mother at the clothesline. Mother remains beside the line and lifts one towel off it. Wet stone paving and the familiar tree remain fixed. A small forward camera lean follows his arrival. End with him stopping beside her, basin at waist height, before the towel falls. Natural rain and hurried footsteps.
